detail.longDescription: I'm a web developer from Ontario, Canada - lifelong Montreal Canadiens fan and avid hockey card collector. Tired of algorithmic rage bait, so I'm looking for a new community. I'm here for lively debates in web dev, cognitive science, AI, hockey and software architecture. I also write about these in my digital garden (link in bio). My handle is from one of many shelved side projects, a hockey card app I plan to resurrect. # introduction # CognitiveScience # AI # Hockey # HockeyCards # WebDev
